subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: After current-main live replay, should #92057 remain the canonical broad gateway availability tracker, or should maintainers split it into narrower handler-specific issues?
rationale: The issue spans multiple gateway RPC and message-delivery paths, and partial fixes already landed without proving the whole workload fixed.

options.title: Replay then split
options.body: Run the reported multi-agent workload on current main/latest release, keep #92057 open for the live proof, and split any confirmed bottleneck into a narrower fix issue.

options.title: Keep as broad tracker
options.body: Use #92057 as the continuing umbrella for gateway liveness work even if individual fixes land separately.

options.title: Close after release proof
options.body: Close only if a current release replay shows logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.list, sessions.compact, and channel delivery remain responsive under the reported load.

recommendation.title: Replay then split
recommendation.body: Run the reported multi-agent workload on current main/latest release, keep #92057 open for the live proof, and split any confirmed bottleneck into a narrower fix issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work localized the central gateway surfaces and makes this the best available owner signal for coordinating the replay and decomposition decision.
